## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy fetcher should respect the existing three-attempt retry cap because its eight-attempt outage path prolongs worker blocking. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds legacy inventory fetching and a health probe with retries, immediate HTTP-error propagation, and exhaustion handling. It also adds parameterized tests and a documented legacy exemption from the retry cap.

(none)

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory retries at three attempts — When every connection attempt fails, the fetcher retries eight times. This violates `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an upstream outage, callers keep worker threads occupied through five extra network attempts and their intervening delays. — Fix: Reduce the limit to three and update the legacy case in `tests/test_retries.py:10`.
